title: CER database.mutation.v1 actuation
description: Actuation payload for the database.mutation.v1 profile. Carries only non-secret identity: connection reference, schema/table, semantic SQL operation, statement/parameter digests, affected-row scope bound, transaction+isolation requirement, expected row-version, and an optional compensation reference. Raw SQL text and credentials are prohibited.

connection_ref.description: Non-secret logical connection identity (e.g. prod-orders). Never a DSN or credential.

sql_operation.description: Semantic operation vocabulary. DELETE is reserved for a future database.delete.v1 (maps to the stricter DB_DELETE class).

statement_digest.description: Digest of the normalized statement. The raw SQL is never in the CER.

estimated_rows.description: Estimated affected-row count as a typed integer string (ActionGate R7 MAX_SCOPE fact affected_count; bound 10000).

unbounded.description: True if the mutation is not row-bounded (ActionGate R7 FORBID fact -> DENY).

expected_row_version.description: Optimistic-concurrency state binding: the row-version the mutation expects.

$comment: Prohibited (fail closed): raw secret-bearing keys (password, dsn, connection_string, credentials, token, statement, sql, ...) anywhere in the actuation, and any Kubernetes-only field (replicas, image_digest, rollout_strategy, ...).
